scope: Reviewed board safeguards, required fallback assets, ML evaluation evidence and documentation; includes prior authentication changes.

checks.name: A caregiver adds a word from a phone photo; the picture is cropped square and stored on the device only
Duplicate labels and non-image files are refused with Kinyarwanda messages
The new word appears in its category on the board with its own photo, and Erekana still works without speech
A familiar-voice recording makes the custom word speak, and its message is kept off the server
Deleting a custom word removes it, its recording and its place on every board
A 9-cell grid shows fixed 3 x 3 pages; turning a page is logged as a navigation action
The last page keeps the grid shape with empty slots, and tiles stay at least 2 cm on a phone
A 40-cell grid fits the whole everyday page, and "Byikora" fits the grid to a tablet and a phone with no page scroll
Personal suggestions need word suggestions on and lift a word this child uses after "I"
The vocabulary review shows the sheet words one at a time, in order, with their voice
Closing the review leaves no trace: no message, action or vocabulary change is stored
Vuga says I + want + water as the sentence “Ndashaka amazi.”, Erekana shows it, and want alone stays “gushaka”
With “Vuga interuro yuzuye” off, the same pictures are spoken word by word again
With next words on, “kunywa” opens drinks (cup, juice, milk) in the grid; one choice returns to the same page without navigation taps
A caregiver changes the pictures after “kunywa” for this child and can restore the starting list
A chosen place puts its words first on the board, core words after them, and opens on its first page
Each picture is said as soon as it is tapped, and a caregiver can switch that off and on
With the section tabs turned off, the caregiver picks the section, or every picture in pages, and can bring the tabs back
Keys show the picture with its word on top, and a caregiver can choose pictures only
The final-feature workflow raised no uncaught page errors
A sideways swipe turns the page without choosing a picture, a tap straight after still chooses, and a caregiver can switch swiping off

Hidden pictures leave an empty key: every other picture keeps its place on each page, for that child only, after a reload; oya, gufasha, kubabara and umusarani cannot be hidden, even by Kuraho yose; all come back in place when shown again
A caregiver edits a child’s name and age band in Abana; the child keeps their id, pictures and board, and the change survives a reload
Deleting a child names them and what goes; Reka keeps everything, and Siba removes only that child, sending the board back to the demo board
Signup validates email inline and shows password requirements without submitting weak credentials
A valid email offers sign-in without revealing account status or sending a lookup
A paused signup keeps the registration form and does not claim creation or verification delivery
Signup code-request failure 503 offers cautious verification recovery and sign-in navigation
Signup code-request failure 429 offers cautious verification recovery and sign-in navigation
Signup keeps its header accessible after scrolling and focused fields unobscured on desktop and phones
Neon signup has no SMS alternative and fits narrow phones
Verification rejects wrong codes and does not open an account session
Resending waits sixty seconds and never requests a password or sends duplicates
A correct verification code requires explicit password login afterward
Password reset validates its email code and confirmation before changing the password
Incorrect account passwords never show the PIN screen or persist authentication
Closing during password authentication discards a late successful response
Returning from PIN setup discards the pending login and clears its credentials
Reloading before PIN confirmation cannot restore a pending account session
A valid account password opens a separate PIN screen; invalid and mismatched PINs cannot finish login
Confirming the PIN stores immutable Neon ownership and a separate hashed offline PIN
Offline PIN access does not send passwords or codes to any service
Name editing saves the adult name, preserves identity and PIN, and works at phone widths
A refused name save keeps the old name; cancel never saves; expired sessions can sign in and retry
Account settings include a complete code-based reset and preserve the local PIN
Relinking authenticates the account first, then verifies the existing PIN without replacing it
Forgotten PIN provides email password reset without granting local access
Recovery refuses a different server identity even with the same email
Fresh authentication by the linked identity permits local PIN recovery
Deletion retries preserve child data and the local PIN while removing only the account link
All authentication traffic used the Vuga API with zero Firebase, Neon-cookie, or SMS requests
The caregiver turns child mode on behind the PIN; the child then sees only nine big pictures
A tap says the word at once, shows it large, and is logged as a device-only child message
A quick accidental second tap on the same picture is ignored; other pictures respond at once
The caregiver switches to a ready-made board and edits it; the child board follows
The game asks for pictures, highlights the answer after two misses, and ends with five stars
Progress appears for the caregiver: stars, first-try finds and words to practise
On a phone in portrait the board uses three columns and keeps every picture over 2 cm
Turning child mode off brings back the full board with its grid and Vuga
Child mode raised no uncaught page errors
Fresh production UI uses rw document language, local artwork and Kinyarwanda controls
All 188 licensed online photos have attribution, are precached, match their manifest and decode at 480 square
A missing photo falls back to its pictogram and remains usable in a composed message
A saved legacy English demo preference migrates to persistent Kinyarwanda
Profile dialog uses Kinyarwanda validation and creates a local profile with 188 choices
Clearing every choice leaves only the four locked words (oya, gufasha, kubabara, umusarani), after a reload too, and all 188 choices can be restored
Appearance settings affect the real board, persist and remain separate for each profile
Real predictions provide three allowed suggestions without moving the main grid
Five rapid taps remain ordered in one draft and Clear adds exactly one correction
Literal Kinyarwanda composition survives caregiver visits and all main tabs use localized copy
Show dialog is localized, keeps background controls inert and restores keyboard focus without completing speech
Every one of the 188 bundled Kinyarwanda clips decodes to non-silent audio
“Ndashaka amazi” plays as two Kinyarwanda clips (ndashaka, amazi) through native media before exactly one Speak completion
Stop interrupts native audio, retains all selected symbols and adds no successful Speak event
Caregiver tests the Kinyarwanda word and a separate speaker tone without any language selector or completion
Silent and corrupt uploads receive Kinyarwanda errors without saving a recording
Valid synthetic upload previews and saves through custom Kinyarwanda audio controls

evidence.fixture: Generated 0.65 s 440 Hz PCM tone, not Kinyarwanda speech.

checks.name: Saved word recording overrides the bundled clip and finalizes one message after playback
Summary, export and account validation remain localized and export real local data only
Phone board fits three readable columns on screen, large touch controls and a wrapping long-message dialog
Operating-system reduced motion disables chip animation even when gentle motion is enabled
Offline reload preserves the profile, predictions, all realistic images and bundled Kinyarwanda playback
Saved recording still overrides speech offline and deletion restores the bundled Kinyarwanda clip
A missing offline clip produces a Kinyarwanda notice, retains the draft and permits visual communication
No English audio is requested or cached, and the complete workflow has no uncaught or native media errors

production_build.existing_warning: Main JavaScript chunk exceeds 500 kB; no new performance claim.

prior_attempts: Initial browser readiness checks timed out during slow local asset loading and precaching. The install allowance is configurable; functional assertions are unchanged.
The missing-photo fallback check exposed ignored pictogram files absent from the release checkout. All 187 declared images are now included, with attribution and an asset-presence regression.

An obsolete phone-only validation fixture was updated for the current email flow; the legacy phone checks run only when that option is offered. No authentication requests are permitted during invalid-input checks.

A native Stop assertion could inspect a very short clip at its end before the ended event arrived. The fixture now observes and stops an active clip in the browser, with explicit pause and no-follow-on-playback checks.
Broad local Python attempts did not complete amid file-stat/import delays. They are not counted as passed; the existing GitHub CI must pass on the pushed release commit before deployment.
ci_gate: Existing push-triggered Python and web jobs must succeed for the exact deploy/vuga-cloud release commit.
limitations: Headless desktop browser checks; no new physical-device study.
Authentication browser tests use mocked API responses and send no real email.
Initial offline installation depends on downloading the complete media pack.
